steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file defining 'Simple App' and package 'com.simpleapp.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the app/build.gradle file with standard AGP 8.3.2 and Target SDK 34.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with the correct namespace, package, and standard Material Light theme.

steps.title: Design User Interface Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml layout with a clean interface containing a counter, dynamic quotes, and a quick note saver.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Java Class
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java with basic package structure, lifecycle hooks, and widget references.

steps.title: Implement Tap Counter Functionality
steps.description: Add simple state tracking to increment, decrement, and reset a tap counter in MainActivity.

steps.title: Implement Quote Generator
steps.description: Add a pre-defined array of positive quotes and a button listener to rotate quotes randomly.

steps.title: Implement Quick Note SharedPreferences Storage
steps.description: Save and load note content using standard SharedPreferences so users don't lose data.

steps.title: Optimize Layout Accessibility and Styling
steps.description: Refine dimensions, colors, and input typings to provide an effortless user experience.

steps.title: Building Simple App
steps.description: Trigger final APK assembly using Gradle with the configured build tools and source code.
